content: To compare the formulary status of a drug with other medications within the same therapeutic class, you must first create a list of applicable plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans to your list enables you to access relevant formulary information. The information provided is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes. It is important to note that individual plans may differ, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, you should contact the respective plan provider directly. When sending information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
